name: Niraparib Maintenance (Epithelial Ovarian/Fallopian Tube/Primary Peritoneal Cancer)
disease: Epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, and primary peritoneal cancer
histology: epithelial ovarian carcinoma (high-grade serous, grade 2/3 endometrioid, or BRCA1/2-mutated clear cell carcinoma or carcinosarcoma per the maintenance-eligible population). Fallopian tube and primary peritoneal carcinoma are treated as ovarian carcinoma.

biomarkers.note: Biomarker gated per Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Ovarian OV-5 v4.2026: niraparib post-primary maintenance is offered for germline or somatic BRCA1/2 P/LP variants (category 1) OR for BRCA1/2 wild-type or unknown WITH HR deficiency; it is NOT offered when disease is BRCA1/2 wild-type or unknown AND HR proficient or HR unknown (observation or bevacizumab is used instead). It is therefore HRD/BRCA-gated in this guideline version, not an all-comers indication. In the post-recurrence maintenance setting, PARP inhibitor maintenance is restricted to BRCA1/2-mutated disease (OV-D footnote a) with no prior PARP progression.

lineOfTherapy: maintenance after response (CR or PR) to platinum-based primary therapy (post-primary), or after response to platinum-based recurrence therapy (post-recurrence, BRCA-mutated only)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: BRCA1/2 P/LP variant, OR BRCA wild-type/unknown with HR deficiency (post-primary); not offered for HR-proficient/unknown
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v4.2026, OV-5 (Niraparib category 1 for BRCA1/2 P/LP; offered for HR Deficient; not listed for HR Proficient/unknown)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: complete or partial response after platinum-based therapy
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v4.2026, OV-D Principles of Maintenance PARP Inhibitor Therapy

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: post-recurrence use requires no prior progression on a PARP inhibitor and is restricted to BRCA1/2-mutated disease

drugs.name: Niraparib

modificationRules.condition: baseline body weight < 77 kg and/or platelet count < 150,000/mm3
modificationRules.text: Source-stated individualized starting dose: 200 mg PO once daily for patients with a baseline body weight of < 77 kg and/or a platelet count of < 150,000/mm3 (Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v4.2026, OV-D).

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Ovarian Cancer/Fallopian Tube Cancer/Primary Peritoneal Cancer
provenance.locator: OV-D, Principles of Maintenance PARP Inhibitor Therapy, Niraparib monotherapy (300 mg PO once daily, or an initial dose of 200 mg once daily for baseline body weight < 77 kg and/or platelet count < 150,000/mm3)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v4.2026, OV-D Principles of Maintenance PARP Inhibitor Therapy. Niraparib 300 mg PO once daily, taken continuously (cycleLengthDays 1 represents continuous daily dosing); individualized starting dose 200 mg once daily for baseline body weight < 77 kg and/or platelet count < 150,000/mm3. Refer to the package insert.

regimen.cycles: continuous once-daily dosing; up to 36 months post-primary maintenance unless disease progression or unacceptable toxicity; until progression or unacceptable toxicity in the post-recurrence (BRCA-mutated) setting
supportiveCare: monitor for cytopenias, especially thrombocytopenia (dose-individualized by baseline platelets and weight); risk of MDS/AML with prolonged exposure.
blood pressure monitoring is required for niraparib.
antiemetic and antihypertensive support as needed per package insert.

monitoring: CBC weekly for the first month then periodically per package insert (thrombocytopenia risk)
blood pressure monitoring is REQUIRED for niraparib (and heart rate)
renal and hepatic function monitoring is recommended
clearanceChecks: CBC/platelets (baseline weight and platelet count for starting dose)

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3+ thrombocytopenia or other prolonged cytopenia
doseModificationRules.text: Interrupt and reduce per package insert weight/platelet-based schedule; evaluate for MDS/AML if prolonged. Physician decides.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: line 178687 (Niraparib 200 to 300 mg once daily); line 179725 (FDA-approved niraparib 200 mg daily for primary maintenance)

guideline.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Ovarian Cancer/Fallopian Tube Cancer/Primary Peritoneal Cancer
guideline.locator: Principles of Maintenance PARP Inhibitor Therapy, Niraparib monotherapy 300 mg PO once daily (or 200 mg for weight < 77 kg and/or platelets < 150,000/mm3), up to 36 months post-primary (OV-D); patient selection OV-5 (BRCA1/2 P/LP category 1; HR Deficient offered; HR Proficient/unknown not offered)

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for single-agent niraparib maintenance in epithelial ovarian carcinoma (StewardMD reference disease ovarian_cancer, subtype #44; shared framework with HGSOC #45, fallopian tube #46, primary peritoneal #47). Dose grounded to Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v4.2026, OV-D Principles of Maintenance PARP Inhibitor Therapy: Niraparib 300 mg PO once daily, with an individualized 200 mg once-daily starting dose for baseline body weight < 77 kg and/or platelet count < 150,000/mm3; up to 36 months in the post-primary setting or until progression in the post-recurrence (BRCA-mutated) setting. Biomarker gate stated per OV-5 v4.2026: offered for BRCA1/2 P/LP (category 1) OR BRCA wild-type/unknown with HR deficiency; NOT offered for HR-proficient or HR-unknown disease (observation or bevacizumab instead) - i.e., HRD/BRCA-gated in this guideline version, not all-comers. Blood-pressure monitoring is required and thrombocytopenia is the key toxicity, with MDS/AML surveillance on prolonged exposure. No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
